description: Score needed on the final exam to reach a desired course grade, with the best and worst possible course grades. Inputs are clamped as on the page: grades to 0 to 100 and the final weight to 1 to 100. Use when the user asks what score they need on a final exam to reach a target course grade. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive Final Exam calculator.
